description: This file defines the SystemSettings class, a data model for system configuration in the OpenBB platform, including methods for creating configuration JSON files and validation logic.

classes.name: SystemSettings
classes.description: A pydantic model representing system configuration settings for the OpenBB platform, including environment info, logging, API, and Python settings.

methods.name: create_json
methods.description: Creates a JSON file at the specified path with optional template data.

methods.name: create_openbb_directory
methods.description: Creates necessary directories and default JSON configuration files if they do not exist.

methods.name: validate_logging_handlers
methods.description: Validates that logging handlers are within the allowed set.
